implementationStateAtFreeze: contract frozen before S13 fixture or confirmatory outcome access
frozenQuestion: Do exact outcome-blind mixtures of the three native policy families change post-completion injury recovery or gradient-permitted target adaptation relative to the equally weighted outcomes of their pure component portfolios, and at what permanent stuck-identity fraction does recovery become unsupported?

priorEvidenceConstraints.s05: Contact-conditioned recovery timing alone was null against matched spontaneous recovery.
priorEvidenceConstraints.s06: Active local rescue did not outperform recovery-time, opportunity, or energy matched controls and is excluded.
priorEvidenceConstraints.s07: Bounded local memory was null against timing, opportunity, and energy matched controls and is excluded.
priorEvidenceConstraints.s08: Plastic modes produced harms and are excluded as validated adaptation.
priorEvidenceConstraints.s12: Bubble and Insertion completed held-out target changes under the frozen gradient controller while Selection did not; compositions may not be chosen or tuned around that observed boundary.
priorEvidenceConstraints.compositionContext: E01 S13 validated all seven same-direction exact pure/pairwise/three-way portfolios as executable and found composition-conditioned aggregation nulls; E01 opposed-direction event-budget results are not imported.

inherits.stabilization: S01 absorbing certificate plus at least two uniform opportunities per identity within 20*n
inherits.checkpointState: occupancy, identity-owned Selection cursors, global activation count, semantic stream counters, native ledger, state hash
inherits.pairing: shared checkpoint and stream prefix within each arm pair; cross-portfolio and immutable-fault-map comparisons are base-draw-paired but scenario-ID RNG-unpaired

portfolios.compositionRule: floor(n/3) each with remainder rotating by base replicate and placement map

assignment.identityInput: cell identity only; no value, position, state, proposal, target, injury, or outcome input
assignment.sensitivityScope: main injury, target-change, and intact-stability panel only; not the threshold grid

criticalFaultThreshold.task: central segment reversal with exact nested post-completion permanent stuck identities
criticalFaultThreshold.faultSemantics: the immutable E02 stuck rule: a stuck identity cannot act or be moved; fault state is not recovery-enabled
criticalFaultThreshold.placementRule: counter-addressed nested identity ranks independent of portfolio, policy, value, position, injury, target, and outcomes
criticalFaultThreshold.population: placement map 0 only; all seven portfolios, both sizes, both directions, eight replicates
criticalFaultThreshold.sequentialRule: evaluate fractions in listed order; fraction 0 reuses the main central-reversal run; after each positive fraction stop the entire threshold family only when every portfolio has Wilson 95% upper success bound below 0.5 at two consecutive evaluated fractions
criticalFaultThreshold.unrunHandling: retain every unexecuted potential row as not_run_prespecified_global_threshold_stop; never silently exclude
criticalFaultThreshold.criticalDefinition: largest evaluated fraction whose Wilson 95% lower success bound is at least 0.5; interval to the first higher evaluated fraction whose upper bound is below 0.5; otherwise boundary-censored/inconclusive
criticalFaultThreshold.monotonicityAudit: report every success-rate increase greater than 0.10 between adjacent evaluated fractions

estimands.population: all assigned base draws, including checkpoint-formation failures, quiescent terminals, event-budget censors, and target-change censors
estimands.primaryCompositionContrast: for each chimeric portfolio and task, chimeric success minus the equally weighted success of its pure component portfolios in the same base-draw block
estimands.policyFamilyReporting: report every pure policy separately and every mixture by exact component set; no pooled chimeric effect may replace family-specific effects
estimands.controllerContrast: within each composition and target, aware minus nonadaptive success with shared checkpoint and scenario RNG prefix
estimands.placementSensitivity: repeat main panel under exact map 1 and compare direction/sign with map 0; do not use it to select a composition

portfolioComplexity: exact assignment description length in bits

inference.primaryIntervals: base-draw block bootstrap 95% percentile intervals with 10000 counter-addressed resamples
inference.primaryTests: two-sided paired sign tests on nonzero block contrasts, Holm adjusted across 16 frozen chimeric-by-task contrasts
inference.secondaryMultiplicity: Holm within separately labeled controller-effect and restricted-time families; all other endpoints descriptive with 95% intervals
inference.successCriterion: at least one Holm-adjusted primary success benefit with positive 95% bootstrap interval, no Holm-adjusted primary harm, and no intact-stability harm
inference.outcomeClassification: supportive if successCriterion holds; constraining/contradictory if a Holm-adjusted primary harm, intact-stability harm, composition/checkpoint validation failure, or boundary violation occurs; null otherwise

terminalHandling.sourceCheckpointFailure: competing terminal; retain all assigned downstream rows as not executable, success false, restricted time budget+1
terminalHandling.phaseEventBudget: right censor; success false; restricted time budget+1
terminalHandling.hazardSummary: discrete cause-specific hazards and cumulative incidence in normalized opportunity-time quartiles; no biological irreversibility claim

required: exact composition counts and policy-assignment hashes
S01 checkpoint-state, phase-budget, target, and stabilization contracts
nested exact stuck-identity sets and E02 fault semantics
deterministic exact replay for every executed trajectory
sequential threshold stopping and unrun-row accounting

claimBoundary: S13 estimates engineered simulator composition effects under the frozen local algorithms, injuries, stuck-fault rule, and gradient target-code interface. It does not establish biological chimerism, natural collective memory, learning, or universal robustness.
